title: Data
intro: All your data (profiles, texts, statistics, words to review) fits in a single file, to keep somewhere safe or copy to another computer.
confirmRestore: Your current data will be replaced by the backup (it is kept alongside), then Dactylo will restart.

updates.title: Updates
updates.privacy: Dactylo only connects to the Internet to look for a new version, and only when you ask it to. No data is sent.
